description: Six-stage shift register — on every clock the voltage at the input moves to the first output and each stored voltage moves on to the next

inputs.text: A rising edge here shifts every stored voltage on by one stage and takes a new reading of the CV input
The voltage read in at each clock

outputs.text: The voltage read in one clock ago
The voltage read in two clocks ago
The voltage read in three clocks ago
The voltage read in four clocks ago
The voltage read in five clocks ago
The voltage read in six clocks ago

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
